title: How Anyone Can Make $10K+/Month From the Government
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The host presents the opportunity as easy, low-cost, and nearly passive, while later adding a clarification about subcontracting rules. No paid sponsorship is disclosed.

idea.name: Government contract prime contractor
idea.one_liner: Bid on government contracts, then arrange for subcontractors to deliver the work; earn the margin between the government price and subcontractor cost.
idea.customer: Government agencies and other public-sector procurers.
idea.offer: A prime contractor that finds suitable contracts, prepares bids, and coordinates subcontractors.
idea.revenue_model: Markup on subcontractor costs, paid by the government under awarded contracts.

When I was trying to win as much as I can, I probably put in maybe two to three hours a day.
So on my contracts, I probably make about 10 to 12,000 on my contracts every single month.
An hour. For all of your contracts combined? The reason I say that is because you just have to put it in an invoice.

idea.customer: Government agencies with hazardous-waste disposal needs.
idea.offer: Arrange pickups and disposal through a qualified waste company.
idea.revenue_model: Markup per pickup under a recurring government contract.
